The mealkit freshness replenishment task succeeded with a perfect verifier reward, validating the integration of inventory and finance logic.
The execution achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and a judge_reward of 0.76 across one trial with zero exceptions. The pytest suite in test_output.py::test_legacy_node_checks passed successfully in 0.144 seconds using pytest version 8.4.1. While the logic for freshness-based replenishment is functional, the lower judge reward suggests potential for optimization in code style or edge-case handling.
